title: MTN South Africa selects Ericsson for voice core transformation
summary: MTN South Africa selects Ericsson Cloud Native IMS for HD voice, 5G voice readiness and AI-powered calling.
body_markdown:
Ericsson (NASDAQ: ERIC) has been selected by MTN South Africa to modernize its voice core network with the deployment of its Cloud Native IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) solution. This will enhance MTN’s network, enabling it to deliver next-generation communication services with superior quality, security, and reliability for its customers across South Africa.


The modernization addresses the need to evolve from legacy systems to a flexible, scalable, and future-proof architecture to meet swiftly evolving customer expectations and provide a base for ambitious new business streams. As the leading operator in the MTN Group, MTN South Africa is driving the future of connectivity by transforming its network with Cloud Native IMS, part of Ericsson’s Cloud IMS portfolio.


By choosing Ericsson Cloud Native IMS, MTN will be empowered to launch a rich portfolio of multimedia services and prepare for the seamless introduction of 5G voice over its 5G Standalone network.


The deployment will roll out across MTN South Africa's core network during 2026 and 2027.


Key capabilities enabled by the IMS modernization will include:


- **HD Voice:** Crystal-clear, high-definition voice and communication services.
- **AI-Enhanced Calling:** Integrating artificial intelligence into voice calls to improve user experience through innovative functionalities like spam call protection and branded calling.
- **Rapid turnaround for new services:** Leveraging cloud-native architecture, underpinned by Ericsson CNIS, for increased agility, scalability, and operational efficiency, will allow MTN to rapidly develop and deploy new services.


By deploying the new Cloud Native IMS solution on Cloud Native Infrastructure Solution (CNIS) using Cloud Execution Environment (CEE) and Cloud Container Distribution (CCD), the same infrastructure already hosting other Ericsson core network functions, MTN South Africa will reduce operational complexity and cost on the infrastructure side, as well as for IMS network operations and maintenance. This is in addition to feeling the benefit of optimized performance and resource allocation.


**Nadeem Amra, Senior Manager Core Planning and Optimization at MTN South Africa, says:** "Modernizing our IMS is a critical step in our mission to provide a world-class network and unparalleled service to our customers. Ericsson's field-proven, Cloud Native IMS solution provides the flexibility and scalability we need to deliver next-generation services, including high-quality 5G voice and innovative AI-powered features. This partnership reinforces our technology leadership and commitment to building a network that is ready for the future."


**Siseko Ngxola, Head of Ericsson South Africa at Ericsson, says:** “MTN is one of South Africa’s leading operators, and this modernization is an important step in its network transformation. It will help strengthen the voice services customers rely on today and prepare MTN to introduce 5G voice and AI-powered calling features. We’re proud to continue our long-standing partnership and support MTN’s ambition to bring next-generation communication services to customers across the country.”


**Fabrizio Cara, Head of Cloud Software and Services at Ericsson West and Southern Africa, says:** “The IMS solution enables MTN to modernize their voice on a common cloud infrastructure already deployed for Ericsson Core Network Functions. The solution is deployed in a separate CEE cluster within the same cloud-native infrastructure, enabling MTN to evolve their services more flexibly, preparing for 5G voice and ultimately introducing advanced features such as spam call protection and branded calling, while simplifying their operations.”


The new Cloud Native IMS solution will not only enhance current voice services like Voice over LTE (VoLTE) but will also serve as a common core for all communication services, simplifying operations and reducing total cost of ownership. This strategic enhancement paves the way for future innovation, allowing MTN South Africa to rapidly develop and deploy new enterprise and consumer services, further solidifying its position at the forefront of Africa's digital evolution.
